notes:
Console 2.3.42. Fixes the crash after 2.3.41 when a scanned signature was on file.
- A phone-camera scan is several megapixels; the report screen decoded it again on every redraw, which ran the console out of memory and closed it. The image is now decoded once, scaled down and reused
- The same scan is scaled to 600px before it is embedded in a printed report, so cards no longer carry a multi-megabyte image
- A failed file picker or a failed save can no longer close the console
- If anything still stops the console, the reason is written to SchoolReportMaker\crash-log.txt next to your data
